prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE finished unlettered comic panel for Nightglass Courier, not a page or collage. Input image 1 supplies original drawing treatment, elegant faces, atmospheric inhabited vertical city; input image 2 supplies stable character/equipment appearance only, not pose, damage, or current inventory. No creatures appear in this scene. Do not copy the sheet white background, weapon display, or Pell tall rig.
Style: controlled thin anime outlines, appealing expressive faces, broad intentional navy/cyan shadow masses, selective warm domestic windows, matte stone, restrained glass/metal highlights. Rich composition and depth, selective meaningful seams; no pervasive tiny scratch/facet texture.
Cast when visible: Aren is the slim young adult courier with swept dark navy hair, ivory cropped jacket over black high collar shirt, black fitted trousers and gloves, red courier cord at belt, black boots. His compact crescent sword has a black grip, curved silver/cyan blade, and one metal pommel ring behind the grip. Pell is the older gray-haired man with short gray beard, mustard jacket and black work harness, without the external pole/rig. Anatomical RIGHT and LEFT always mean the person's own hands. No duplicated weapons. The cream belt wallet stays shut and never becomes the black envelope.
Location: an exterior old postal stair in the vertical night city. Upper stone stair/landing above-left; lower stone postal landing three metres below-right, with one squat BLACK metal anchor post, a projecting iron handrail tooth next to that post, and a closed iron wicket blocking the regular stairs.

Single frozen visible instant: Aren applies Hold and slows at the lower landing. Boots touch stone; his LEFT elbow catches the projecting iron tooth beside the post, making one clear tear in the ivory LEFT sleeve. His right sword points down-left; cyan line remains ring-to-post, taut during his last braking instant; boots are just making contact.
Framing: medium side, feet and snag readable.
Current state at this instant: New torn LEFT elbow sleeve; previous torn hem persists. Envelope still hidden chest. One ring-to-post line, no blade contact with rail.
Composition: landscape 3:2 panel. Reserve quiet upper 22% for later editable lettering while keeping all significant hands, face, envelope, sleeve damage and any line endpoints readable below it. No words, labels, captions, balloons, sound effects, status cards, or decorative borders in raster art. Do not show subsequent events. An inactive pommel has no glow or cyan line.
